Build the harmonized organization table from NCCS downloads

Source: R/source-nccs.R
npc_build_nccs.Rd

Downloads the NCCS CORE 990combined files and the unified geocoded BMF for the requested tax years, harmonizes them to the canonical schema with npc_standardize(), and writes them to dir/filers/ as a Parquet dataset partitioned by YEAR, the same layout as npc_build_archive(). Years already built are kept, so the table can be grown a few years at a time. npc_get_orgs() and npc_build_metrics() with source = "nccs" call this for any year they need that is not built yet.

Usage

npc_build_nccs(years, dir = npc_cache_dir(), refresh = FALSE, keep_raw = TRUE)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of tax years. NCCS publishes 990combined files from 2010, so the earliest full tax year is 2010.

dir

Cache directory; see npc_cache_dir(). Any folder works, so a live build can be kept as a frozen archive.

refresh

Download the NCCS files again and rebuild the requested years even if they are cached.

keep_raw

Keep the downloaded CORE files after the build. The BMF is always kept.

Value

The cache directory, invisibly. It holds filers/, year-counts.csv (rows per tax year, with the files and BMF used), manifest.csv and downloads.csv (URL, size and MD5 of every file).

Details

Tax year t combines December year ends from CORE file t with other year ends from file t + 1, so it needs both files. A tax year whose t + 1 file holds less than 80% of the rows of file t is flagged incomplete (see npc_archive_info()).

Location and subsector come from the unified BMF, one record per EIN, so an organization that moved is placed at its latest address in every year. The county is found by matching the geocoded county and state names to pop_county (see npc_match_county()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
npc_build_nccs( 2018:2020 )
npc_archive_info( npc_cache_dir() )
} # }
